scope: Zero-training, CPU-only, read-only explanatory audit of whether the same-image other-task prompt is a valid negative for the operational prompt-utility diagnostic. It re-derives geometry and re-aggregates already-reported val metrics; it does not change the prior NOT_ESTABLISHED decision and makes no accuracy or promotion claim.
chronology: This config and the companion preregistration report were written before any byte of the operational records CSV, the clean manifest JSONL, or the operational JSON was read. Only SHA256 hashing of the pinned inputs occurred before freezing.

reports/token_selector/2026-10-03-operat.role: val-only per (arm, seed, sample_id, task, budget) metric records
corresponding operational diagnostic JSON for cross-check and provenance

datasets/prompt_projection_clean_inducti.role: clean manifest supplying ground_truth.point_1000 and ground_truth.bbox_1000 geometry only

data_scope.split: val only, derived from the operational records CSV (every row is a val record); no index or NPZ is read

geometry.coordinate_frame: normalized [0, 1000]; flat group index row-major g = r*W + c
geometry.point_inside_bbox: inclusive test (x1 - 1e-9) <= x <= (x2 + 1e-9) and (y1 - 1e-9) <= y <= (y2 + 1e-9), reuse evaluation.spatial_teacher_feasibility_audit.point_inside_bbox
geometry.point_inside_bbox_overall_ratio_primary: count of val records whose own ground_truth.point_1000 lies inside their own ground_truth.bbox_1000, divided by the val record count (76)
geometry.point_inside_bbox_image_ratio_secondary: count of val images whose pointing-record point_1000 lies inside the same image's grounding-record bbox_1000, divided by the val image count (38)
geometry.bbox_area_norm: (clip(x2,0,1000) - clip(x1,0,1000)) * (clip(y2,0,1000) - clip(y1,0,1000)) / 1e6, from the grounding record

aggregation.seed_to_image_task: median across the three seeds of gap_retained_spatial_target_mass for each (image, task)
aggregation.image_to_task_marginal: mean across the 38 val images of the per-image per-task median gap
aggregation.overall: mean across the 38 val images of the per-image mean of the grounding and pointing median gaps (secondary)
aggregation.stratification_by_point_inside: images grouped by point-inside-bbox boolean; report per-stratum count and per-task gap mean
aggregation.bbox_area_vs_grounding_gap_spearman: Spearman rank correlation across the 38 val images between grounding bbox_area_norm and the per-image grounding K48 median gap; reuse evaluation.prompt_projection_distillation.spearman

jaccard.per_task: median across the three seeds, then mean across the 38 val images, for grounding and pointing separately
jaccard.stratified_by_point_inside: same, reported within each point-inside stratum

cross_check.operational_json_task_k48: grounding and pointing B K48 correct-minus-wrong gap-mass means and B K48 correct-wrong jaccard means must match the re-aggregated values within 1e-9; a mismatch is reported, not silently corrected
cross_check.prior_decision_unchanged: the prior OPERATIONAL_PROMPT_UTILITY_NOT_ESTABLISHED decision is untouched by this audit

prohibitions: internal test access (no resolve, hash, open, parse or score)
modifying any pre-existing file other than the required CURRENT_STATUS.md update
honesty: Explanatory diagnostic only. It neither changes the prior NOT_ESTABLISHED result nor supports any accuracy or promotion statement.
